result.instructions: Tools for Universe, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my live Universe events and how many tickets each one sold."; "Who bought tickets for my next event?"; "Show ticket sales per day for the last two weeks for my event.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Universe data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run universe_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run universe_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run universe_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. universe_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: universe_get_viewer
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in Universe user and the host accounts they can manage (team memberships). Use a host id with universe_list_events. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events (id, title, url, state, first date, venue, tickets sold). Without hostId it lists the signed-in user's own events; with hostId it lists that host account's events (ids come from universe_get_viewer). Read-only.

hostId.description: Host account id. Omit for your own events.

states.description: Only events in these states, e.g. POSTED.

search.description: Text to match in the event title (host events only).

offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: universe_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch one event by id: description, address, dates, capacity, tickets sold, sales amount, category and host. For ticket types use universe_list_ticket_types. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_ticket_types
tools.title: List ticket types
tools.description: List the ticket types (rates) of an event: name, price, capacity, sold count, state and sales window. Read-only.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: universe_list_time_slots
tools.title: List time slots
tools.description: List the dates and time slots of an event (start, end, capacity, tickets sold, state). Optionally filter by start date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only.

startAfter.description: Only slots that start after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

startBefore.description: Only slots that start before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: universe_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the orders of an event: buyer name and email, state, price breakdown, created and updated time. Filter by order state, text match or updated-since time. Contains buyer personal data. Read-only.

states.description: Only orders in these states, e.g. PAID.

match.description: Text to match (buyer name, email or order reference).

updatedSince.description: Only orders updated since this ISO 8601 time.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: universe_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch one order by id: buyer, state, cost breakdown, time slot, checkout answers and the ticket items with their check-in state. Read-only.

tools.name: universe_list_attendees
tools.title: List attendees
tools.description: List the attendees (ticket holders) of an event: name, email, ticket type, time slot, ticket state and checkout answers. Filter by ticket state, text match or time slot. Contains personal data. Read-only.

states.description: Only tickets in these states, e.g. PAID.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: universe_event_sales_by_day
tools.title: Event sales by day
tools.description: Return ticket sales per day for an event between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Read-only.
